description.value: Stuffies Pastries is a North Vancouver café bringing a South Korean animal-shaped waffle pastry concept to Vancouver, with custard- and jam-filled treats as their signature item. The cafe also serves coffee and beverages, soft-serve ice cream, and sandwiches, salads, and soups, making it a reasonable stop for a sweet or savoury refuel. It is part of a small multi-location chain with stores in Burnaby and Surrey as well.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the OSM phone number (604-971-1000) and address (1571 Oxford St, North Vancouver). The stuffies menu page explicitly lists a 'Vegan/GF' option, and the online ordering system (Add to Cart buttons) confirms takeout capability. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The cafe is a legitimate food and drink business useful to touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. On-site verification is needed before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Stuffies menu page lists '24 Pieces Reg. Vegan/GF (Min. Order 48 pcs.)' as an explicit option
